issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Animal.name attribute to be a StringBuilder for efficient name modifications, but the reference solution implements the name attribute as a String (Animal.java). This discrepancy between the specification and the solution may confuse students about the expected attribute type and the required getter/setter signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement: change Animal.java to store name as a private StringBuilder. Update the constructor to initialize the StringBuilder (e.g., new StringBuilder(name)), and provide getter/setter that operate on StringBuilder (or return StringBuilder while ensuring other classes that use getName() still function, since StringBuilder concatenates correctly in message strings). Alternatively, if String is preferred, update the problem statement to remove the explicit requirement to use StringBuilder so the specification and solution match.
